delivered.body: Commercial Lease Agreement PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties as Landlord and the Tenant. 1. PREMISES. The Landlord leases to the Tenant the premises at 400 Harbor Street. 2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay the monthly Base Rent set out below. 4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease, or any interest therein, without the prior written consent of the Landlord, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Any purported assignment without such consent shall be void. 4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign without the Landlord's consent.
